MasulloGRH.Round11A.archimedean_product_order.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (R : Finset ι) (C : Finset κ)
  (r : ι → ℂ) (c : κ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) :
  meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (∏ i ∈ R, (z + r i).Gammaℝ) * ∏ j ∈ C, (z + c j).Gammaℂ) x =
    ∑ i ∈ R, meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (z + r i).Gammaℝ) x +
      ∑ j ∈ C, meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (z + c j).Gammaℂ) x

MasulloGRH.Round11A.finite_product_divisor.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} (S : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℂ)
  (hF : ∀ i ∈ S, MeromorphicAt (F i) x) :
  MeromorphicAt (fun z => ∏ i ∈ S, F i z) x ∧
    meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => ∏ i ∈ S, F i z) x = ∑ i ∈ S, meromorphicOrderAt (F i) x

MasulloGRH.Round11A.coincident_archimedean_poles.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (R : Finset ι) (C : Finset κ)
  (r : ι → ℂ) (c : κ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) (nr : ι → ℕ) (nc : κ → ℕ) (hr : ∀ i ∈ R, (x + r i) / 2 = -↑(nr i))
  (hc : ∀ j ∈ C, x + c j = -↑(nc j)) :
  meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (∏ i ∈ R, (z + r i).Gammaℝ) * ∏ j ∈ C, (z + c j).Gammaℂ) x = R.card • -1 + C.card • -1

MasulloGRH.Round11A.normalized_archimedean_completion_order.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (R : Finset ι)
  (C : Finset κ) (r : ι → ℂ) (c : κ → ℂ) (L : ℂ → ℂ) (x A : ℂ) (Q : ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hQ : 0 < Q)
  (hL : MeromorphicAt L x) :
  meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => A * ↑Q ^ (z / 2) * (((∏ i ∈ R, (z + r i).Gammaℝ) * ∏ j ∈ C, (z + c j).Gammaℂ) * L z)) x =
    ∑ i ∈ R, meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (z + r i).Gammaℝ) x +
        ∑ j ∈ C, meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (z + c j).Gammaℂ) x +
      meromorphicOrderAt L x

MasulloGRH.Round11A.archimedean_divisor_count.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (R : Finset ι) (C : Finset κ)
  (r : ι → ℂ) (c : κ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) :
